response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS match_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_matches, AVG(g.match_count - b.avg_match_count) AS average_excess FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.match_count > b.avg_match_count

assumptions.assumption: A zero feerate makes the ratio undefined, so it is excluded from ratio averages while its matched row still counts.
